reads: every tools/*.mjs, comment-blanked, against the two shapes the brief published as greps. The shape is not the exposure: an adopter still matches its own shape, so this gate subtracts an adopter BY NAME.

write.enumeratedWith: the brief §1 grep: a root from `import.meta.url`, filtered by `writeFileSync` or `appendFileSync`
write.adoptedMeans: the tool calls writeRoot or writeRootOrDie where the write happens
write.pendingMeans: the tool matches the shape and owes one reading in its own header (brief §3). A name leaves this list only by adopting, or with the file.
write.exemptMeans: the regexes read the tool’s own test data. Each row carries the sentence that says why, and a mute row reds.

tools/new-changeset.mjs.reading: it writes a tracked work-unit artifact, `changes/<slug>.md`, which a wrong checkout loses (row 2026-11-02-a-tool-run-by-absolute-path-writes-into-its-own-checkout)

exempt.tools/write-root-adoption.mjs: its selftests plant both shapes as fixture strings, so the write regexes read its own test data; it writes no tracked artifact and calls no write wrapper

judge.enumeratedWith: the brief §6.2 grep: a verdict, `fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)`, and that root as a child `cwd`
judge.adoptedMeans: the tool calls judgeRoot or judgeRootOrDie where the judge happens
judge.pendingMeans: the tool matches the shape and owes one reading in its own header (brief §6.4). A name leaves this list only by adopting, or with the file.
judge.exemptMeans: the regexes read the tool’s own test data. Each row carries the sentence that says why, and a mute row reds.

tools/residue-path-leads.mjs.reading: it reads a ref and a git log with `cwd: REPO`, so a cross-checkout run would report another checkout's ledger as this one's

tools/run-check.mjs.reading: it runs the whole local gate in the tree it resolves, so a cross-checkout run would judge another work-unit

tools/secret-scan.mjs.reading: it judges the commits the RUN’s branch adds (#4384, row 2026-11-04-a-verdict-gate-judges-the-checkout-it-lives-in-not-the-one-it-ran-from)

tools/write-root-adoption.mjs.reading: it censuses the tool tree of the RUN’s work-unit and publishes a verdict about it
